trigger: pilot-01-r1 (validation) failed die-five calibration at the middle marker: about 2 s after the 26 s reset, True Skate swung its camera ~180 degrees around the stationary board with no touch, just after the idle navigation bar appeared, and was still settling when the 29 s marker landed. All 15 touches were on schedule; the start and end markers detected 5/5. It is the first die-five failure in about 25 recordings that reached calibration.
rule: A recording whose only failure is die-five calibration loses its ten candidates without replacement and capture continues while total losses stay within 30 candidates (5%). Any other failure or any rejected candidate still stops the pilot for diagnosis. pilot-01 resumes with its unattempted recordings r2-r4.
consequences: Corpus at most 590 clips; validation at most 90. Clips captured after this amendment carry a new bound-context fingerprint.
